ei.title: Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

fullPassage:
Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.

questions.passage: Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two (A)[distinct / similar] Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong. Defenders could fight from higher ground and (B)[effectively / barely] push back enemies with fewer soldiers. Living in the sanseong was not practical due to (C)[scarce / abundant] farmland and poor living conditions though. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century. Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 두 별개의(distinct) 한국식 양식. 효과적으로(effectively) 적을 격퇴. 부족한(scarce) 농경지.
det.analysis:
✅ ① distinct–effectively–scarce: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ② similar: 산성과 읍성은 '별개의' 양식이지 '유사한' 양식이 아님
❌ ③ barely(거의 ~않게): 효과적으로 격퇴한다는 맥락에 부적합
❌ ④ abundant(풍부한): 산성에서 농경지가 '부족'해서 비실용적
det.tip: distinct(별개의) ↔ similar(유사한) / scarce(부족한) ↔ abundant(풍부한)

questions.passage: Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they (A)[withdrew / advanced] to the nearby sanseong for safety. After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the (B)[strengths / weaknesses] of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong (C)[displayed / concealed] strong walls and defenses.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 산성으로 철수했다(withdrew). 양쪽의 강점(strengths)을 결합. 강한 성벽과 방어를 보여주었다(displayed).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ withdrew–strengths–displayed: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① weaknesses: 강점을 결합한 것이지 약점이 아님
❌ ② concealed(숨겼다): 성벽을 보여준 것이지 숨긴 것이 아님
❌ ④ advanced(전진했다): 안전을 위해 철수한 것이지 전진이 아님
det.tip: withdrew(철수했다) ↔ advanced(전진했다) / displayed(보여주었다) ↔ concealed(숨겼다)

questions.passage: This fortress (A)[artfully / clumsily] blends two distinct Korean styles. Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by (B)[utilizing / ignoring] Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that (C)[combined / emerged] the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② artfully–utilizing–combined: 모두 원문 적합. (C)는 'emerged that combined'에서 combined가 핵심
❌ ① emerged: 동사가 아닌 관계절 속 동사이므로 combined가 정답
❌ ③ ignoring(무시하여): 지형을 활용한 것이지 무시한 것이 아님
❌ ④ clumsily(서투르게): 교묘하게 혼합한 것이지 서투르게가 아님
det.tip: artfully(교묘하게) ↔ clumsily(서투르게) / utilizing(활용하여) ↔ ignoring(무시하여)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

❌ ②③④: 모두 원문 그대로 적절

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ defenders(수비자): 산성에서 방어하는 사람 = defenders. fight from higher ground + push back enemies의 주어

❌ ② soldiers(군인): 일반적이지만 원문은 defenders

questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어를 고르시오.
"A large, strong building or group of buildings that can be defended from attack"

det.korean: 공격으로부터 방어될 수 있는 크고 강한 건물 → fortress(요새)

questions.passage:
Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for ____.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수원 화성은 방어뿐 아니라 농업, 상업, 주거의 중심이기도 했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② agriculture, commerce, and housing: 원문 그대로. 방어 + 일상생활의 융합
❌ ① only military: 군사만이 아님 — '방어와 일상생활의 융합'이 핵심
❌ ③ religious ceremonies: 원문에 없는 내용
❌ ④ scientific research: 원문에 없는 내용
det.tip: Suwon Hwaseong = 방어(defenses) + 일상(daily life: agriculture, commerce, housing)
